metadata.title: Secure Survey

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for conducting surveys in a manner that preserves informed consent, privacy, ethical commitments, and institutional trust.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Survey platforms, questionnaire systems, response collection services, and survey data management environments.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Composite Secure Survey architecture composed of survey trust foundations, consent and ethics governance, identity and anonymity handling, and post-collection data protection.

props.name: data-entity
props.remarks: Survey instruments, consent artifacts, respondent metadata, responses, audit logs, and lifecycle management records.

props.name: dependency-class
props.remarks: Secure Survey is a Tier-2 institutional capability with high privacy, ethical, and reputational impact.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Secure Survey inherits baseline survey trust properties from Survey Core.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Secure Survey relies on Secure Identity for respondent eligibility, authentication where required, and identity separation controls.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Secure Survey relies on Secure Network for protected transport, availability, and monitoring.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Secure Survey relies on Secure Email for controlled survey distribution and notifications.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Use of valid accounts or access mechanisms to improperly influence or deanonymize survey participation.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Manipulation or falsification of survey responses undermines institutional decision-making and trust.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Collection and misuse of sensitive information through improperly governed surveys.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Clear identity binding and separation prevents unintended association between respondents and responses.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Lifecycle governance reduces residual risk from retained survey instruments and data.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Auditability and traceability support accountability and investigation of survey misuse.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Secure Survey aligns with NIST SP 800-53 security and privacy control families relevant to surveys involving human participants.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Surveys frequently cross organizational and system boundaries, requiring explicit trust and responsibility definition.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Survey capabilities may be required during institutional disruption and must remain ethical and available under stress.

metadata.remarks: Secure Survey is the composite governance pattern defining why surveys are treated as a distinct security, privacy, and ethics domain. ATT&CK and D3FEND references in this pattern are included solely to justify institutional controls and do not represent implementation-level threat mitigation. Detailed enforcement is defined in Survey Core and associated constraint patterns.
